TC-22/S27.title: Save & Extract on one chart leaves every other chart's matching tasks alone (two charts per context)
TC-22/S27.detail: Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s27-other-charts.spec.ts, 13/13 judged. Four charts (A, B Hospital; R, R2 Nursing Home) with the same three tasks. Save & Extract on A: the request carries A's open tasks only; A's BMP and PT done and the diet task added on A; B, R, R2 deep-equal their seed (ids, text, done, doneAt); Hospital Task Export groups B's three tasks under B and A's finished rows under A's name only; Nursing Home Task Export unchanged. Then on R: R closes and gets the diet task, R2 deep-equals its seed, A and B unchanged; both Task Exports scoped by name. Whether the live model closes A's tasks is S01/S03's dev half; nothing a model answers can reach another chart, since the request carries only this chart's tasks.
